name: Akroma's Will
oracle_text:
Choose one. If you control a commander as you cast this spell, you may choose both instead.
• Creatures you control gain flying, vigilance, and double strike until end of turn.
• Creatures you control gain lifelink, indestructible, and protection from each color until end of turn.
blocked_sentences: Choose one. If you control a commander as you cast this spell, you may choose both instead.
• Creatures you control gain lifelink, indestructible, and protection from each color until end of turn.

needs.what: A modal spell whose mode count is a floor rather than an exact number: choose one, and if a cast-time condition holds the controller *may* choose additional modes. Needs `choose_mode` to take an optional upper bound (e.g. `up_to`, gated by a `condition` evaluated as the spell is cast) so the decision is offered as min 1 / max 2 rather than forced.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `choose_mode` has a `count`, but `ask_mode` builds the decision with `min_count = max_count = count`, and short-circuits with `if len(labels) <= count: return list(range(len(labels)))`. So a count of 2 over 2 modes does not ask at all -- it silently executes both. Making count conditional (`sum` of `{"const": 1}` and a `count` over an `is_commander` selector) computes the right *number*, but produces a card that must choose both whenever a commander is out, deleting the printed choice. There is no way to express an optional extra mode.

needs.what: An effect op that grants protection from a set of qualities (colors, types, subtypes) to a pool of permanents until end of turn -- the effect half of the existing `protection` static, usable from `spell_effects`, with `from_colors` naming all five colors for "protection from each color".
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `protection` exists only as a *printed static ability* on a permanent: `characteristics.protection_from` collects candidates from `_battlefield_statics`, which walks `card.abilities` of battlefield objects only and never consults granted or temporary effects. `grant_keyword` cannot carry it -- `loader.py` deliberately excludes `protection` from the keyword list because it is parameterised ("protection from Wizards" names a quality, and four rules read it). `grant_ability` hands over an entry from the granter's `grantable_abilities` as an until-EOT `TempEffect(kind='ability')`, which `granted_abilities` surfaces to triggers and legality, but the statics pipeline never reads it -- so a granted protection static would be inert.
